author: Sebastian Sala
description: Unofficial plugin for roo. Add it to the Gemfile and Roo::Excelx reads worksheets through a Rust extension instead of Nokogiri, building the same Roo::Excelx::Cell objects. Anything the native reader does not reproduce exactly goes to roo's own code. Not affiliated with roo-rb.
